identity.name: RevvLot
identity.tagline: Old School Hustle. New School Wheels.
identity.one_line_description: RevvLot is a retro-styled used car marketplace where buyers browse, inspect, and reserve quality pre-owned vehicles with full transparency and zero dealership drama.

sections.intent: Walk the visitor through the simple step-by-step process of buying a car on RevvLot so it feels approachable and frictionless.
sections.headline: From Browse to Keys — Here's the Play-by-Play

items.title: Step 1 — Browse
items.description: Filter by make, model, year, price, and mileage. Every listing includes photos, specs, and a full history report.

items.title: Step 2 — Inspect
items.description: Read the 120-point inspection report, watch the walkaround video, and ask our team any questions via live chat.

items.title: Step 3 — Reserve

items.title: Step 4 — Close
items.description: Complete paperwork online or in person at your nearest RevvLot partner location. Pick up or get it delivered.

sections.intent: Answer the most common pre-reservation questions to eliminate the final objections that prevent buyers from completing the hold.
sections.headline: Everything You're Wondering About the $99 Hold

items.title: Is the $99 really refundable?
items.description: Yes. 100%. If you decide not to buy for any reason — or no reason at all — we refund your $99 within 1 business day. No questions, no fees, no hassle.

items.title: How long does the hold last?
items.description: Your hold keeps the vehicle off the market for 5 business days. Need more time? Contact your advisor and we'll work with you.

items.title: Can I still negotiate the price after reserving?
items.description: The listed price is already market-validated and firm. What you see is what you pay — no negotiation theater.

items.title: What happens after I place the hold?
items.description: You'll get an email confirmation immediately. Your RevvLot advisor will contact you within 2 business hours to schedule inspection, arrange financing if needed, and confirm delivery or pickup.

items.title: Can I reserve more than one car?
items.description: You can place holds on up to 2 vehicles at a time. Each hold is independent and fully refundable.
